shortBio.en: Who drummer; tom-heavy fills and unstable pulse on 1960s–70s records.
shortBio.zh: The Who 鼓手；1960–70 年代唱片上偏 tom 的加花与不稳定脉冲。

body.en: Born 1946, London. Joins mid-1960s. Drumming favors fills and crash over strict backbeat. Dies 1978.
body.zh: 1946 年生于伦敦。1960 年代中期加入。鼓点偏加花与吊镲，而非死板背拍。1978 年去世。
